name: CommentThread
summary: Threaded discussion attached to an entity (a row, an annotation marker, a document range). Renders a list of Comments (avatar + author + time + body + reactions + inline editor on hover-actions), nested Replies one-level-deep, an inline ChatComposer at the bottom, and an optional 'Resolve' affordance.

comments.description: Array of { id, author, time, dateTime, body, reactions?, replies?, edited? }.

composerSlot.description: Render the inline composer. Defaults to a plain textarea with a Send IconButton.

rules: Replies rendered inside their parent comment as a nested <ol>.
Resolved state announces 'Thread resolved' via aria-live and visually dims the thread.

do: Render replies one level deep — past that, summarize 'N more replies'.
Show the Resolve affordance at the thread header (not on individual comments).
When resolved, dim the thread to text.tertiary + keep it visible (don't hide; auditability matters).
dont: Don't allow infinite nesting — hard cap at one reply level.
Don't render the inline composer outside the thread context.
Don't paint resolved threads in lime fill — use a subtle tint.
